title: Repository baseline commit
decision: Use commit 308028fb (v1.11.0) as the pinned baseline for all source-grounded artifacts.
rationale: This is the current HEAD of the master branch. The official documentation displayed v1.11.0 when the master prompt was prepared.
author: architect

title: Standards baseline selection
decision: Lock to ISO 26262:2018 (Parts 1-12) and Automotive SPICE PAM 4.1 (VDA QMC English release 2026-08-24).
rationale: Per master prompt Section 3, these are the mandated baselines. Do not mix with older editions.
author: safety

title: Profile separation: as_is vs synthetic_reference
decision: Maintain two explicitly separated profiles sharing a controlled source registry. as_is = faithful reconstruction of pinned sources. synthetic_reference = complete hypothetical automotive BMS project grounded in foxBMS.
rationale: Per master prompt Section 5. Required for honest representation of synthetic vs observed content.
author: architect

title: ID scheme
decision: Use stable, globally unique, readable IDs with format FB2-<DOMAIN>-<TYPE>-<NNNNNN> (e.g., FB2-SYS-REQ-000123). Profile/scenario namespace rules to be defined in schemas.
rationale: Per master prompt Section 6. Never renumber established IDs when inserting records.
author: architect

title: Vertical slice selection
decision: First vertical slice will cover cell voltage monitoring -> safe operating area -> contactor control chain, as this is a core safety function demonstrated in the foxBMS source.
rationale: Cell voltage monitoring (AFE driver), SOA monitoring (application/algorithm), and contactor control (driver/contactor) are all present in the source and form a complete safety chain.
author: architect
